name: TechWithNavi Pages Taxonomy Manager
author: Naveen Gaur

sections.description:
TechWithNavi Pages Taxonomy Manager allows you to add dedicated Categories and Tags
to WordPress Pages.

These taxonomies are separate from Posts, preventing admin menu
conflicts and label duplication.

Features

  • Page Categories taxonomy
  • Page Tags taxonomy
  • Clean settings page
  • REST & Gutenberg support
  • Page-builder friendly
  • Lightweight and fast
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Go to Settings → Pages Taxonomy Manager
sections.faq:
Are these taxonomies shared with posts?

No. Page taxonomies are completely separate.

Does this fix duplicate “Tags” menu issues?

Yes. Page Tags use a dedicated taxonomy.
